create_R2D2Net: create an R2D2Net neural network with LSTM layers and dueling Q-value architecture for Hanabi reinforcement learning
run_R2D2Net_forward: run the R2D2Net forward pass to compute Q-values, greedy actions, and LSTM outputs from private state tensors
create_R2D2Agent: create an R2D2Agent with online and target networks for prioritized experience replay in Hanabi multi-agent RL
run_R2D2Agent_act: run the R2D2Agent act method to select epsilon-greedy actions from observation dictionaries with LSTM hidden states
run_R2D2Agent_loss: run the R2D2Agent loss method to compute TD error and auxiliary prediction loss for training the agent
